description:
Welcome to ELECTRO SCHOOL.

Here, electrical engineering is explained visually and step by step.

We cover three-phase systems, electric motors, circuit breakers, RCDs, contactors, relays, PLCs, transformers, electrical faults, industrial automation and many other practical electrical topics.

The goal is simple: understand what is actually happening inside the circuit — not just memorize a diagram.

New educational videos regularly.

Understand electricity. Don’t just memorize it.
